prompt:
You are a senior ML researcher generating candidates only; do NOT rank, reject, assert novelty, or declare publishability. Return exactly one JSON object shaped {"shard_id":"lens:phm-generalization","candidates":[{"kind":"idea","title":...,"method_steps":[...],"falsifiable_hypothesis":...,"minimum_experiment":...,"contribution_type":...,"risk":...,"effort":...,"closest_prior_families":[...],"so_what":...,"dedup_key":...}]} with exactly 8 candidates.
Direction: publishable multi-agent architecture for causal online prognostics, with public capacitor degradation as primary domain and numerical small models as strong executors. Accuracy on unseen physical units first. Evaluate across public capacitor, battery, turbofan and bearing prognostics families without erasing capacitor-specific C/ESR/SOH/RUL semantics. Enforce strict rolling-origin, delayed/censored outcomes, group holdout, no leakage, numerical scoring and safe fallback.
Known close work: REATS, CastFSR, CastFlow, Nexus, TS-Debate, KairosAgent, TimeClaw and general dynamic graph routers. Avoid generic role decomposition, generic routing or simple apply-LLM-to-PHM.
Lens: cross-domain PHM transfer, heterogeneous observation/endpoint semantics, mechanism/tool registries, agent graph grammar, separation of universal architecture from domain-specific numerical tools, and informative negative results. Moderate compute; no subjective LLM scoring.
Hard comparison requirement: every candidate must explicitly cover a pure LLM Agent directly emitting C/ESR/SOH/RUL and LLM Agent plus specialized numerical-model hybrid modes for direct prediction, residual correction and fusion. Compare direct and hybrid arms under the same information and matched budgets, and require RUL=NA whenever RUL is not identifiable. Include a falsifiable hypothesis, mechanism, minimum experiment, closest-prior risk and failure condition for every candidate.
